description.value:
Frequency once per encounter

Range 60 feet

Every ally who can hear and understand you immediately ends one condition of their choice from among frightened, fleeing, sickened, stupefied, and off-guard, and becomes immune to that condition from any source for one minute. You may not use this on yourself; nobody has ever given you the order.

cinderfall.incomplete: Every ally ends one condition of their choice (frightened/fleeing/sickened/stupefied/off-guard) and is immune to it for 1 minute; not usable on the caster. Condition removal and a following immunity window on multiple different creatures has no rule-element path -- the closest real precedent (Liberating Step) confirms the general effect-class ships unencoded but provides no actual hook, and this card's scale (every ally, their choice of condition, plus a following immunity window) goes further than any single real precedent found in this pass.
